OPTIONS.team: SELECT team_id, name FROM teams ORDER BY name
OPTIONS.event: SELECT event_id, name FROM events ORDER BY end_date DESC, event_id DESC
OPTIONS.map: SELECT map_id, name FROM maps ORDER BY name
OPTIONS.match:
SELECT m.match_id, m.match_date || ' | ' || a.name || ' vs ' || b.name || ' | ' || e.name
        FROM matches m
        JOIN teams a ON a.team_id = m.team1_id JOIN teams b ON b.team_id = m.team2_id
        JOIN stages s ON s.stage_id = m.stage_id JOIN events e ON e.event_id = s.event_id
        ORDER BY COALESCE(datetime(m.scheduled_at), datetime(m.match_date)) DESC, m.match_id DESC

NOTES.2: Lineups reflect the most recent match recorded for this team.
NOTES.3: Start times include the Central European UTC offset. Dates are inclusive.
NOTES.7: Estimated total damage sums ADR × rounds played across maps with published ADR.
NOTES.8: Includes teams with no matches during the selected dates.
